authority_statement: Independent technical structural study only; not Deere CAD, engineering authority, training material, operational guidance, or manufacturer endorsement.
rights_boundary: Independently authored geometry and neutral unbranded materials. No copied CAD, textures, logos, publication pages or first-party imagery is shipped.

scene.machine_axes: +X toward harvester head/front, +Y vertical, +Z machine right

bounds.note: Decoded directly from every reachable GLB POSITION vertex with composed node transforms; retained working pose, not the published transport envelope.

detail.method: Decode every reachable shipped-GLB POSITION vertex, compose node transforms, and compare the lateral AABB dimension to the published 600-series minimum-width datum.
Compose shipped-GLB node TRS from the active scene roots and compare every deterministic build-input pivot world translation.
Decode shipped-GLB parent indices and compare the CH7 slew/lift/fold/telescope/head chain to the required exported hierarchy.
Resolve every viewer Auto/manual motion target by exact name in the decoded shipped-GLB node table.
Resolve each explicitly static CH7 hydraulic barrel/rod component by exact name in the decoded shipped GLB; no dynamic closure is claimed.
Hash the deterministic build-input file, verify its machine/configuration identity at load time, and bind its unique retained fact IDs to the manufacturer constraints copied into the receipt.
